summary:
蘋果營收與獲利雙雙超預期，年增達16.36%，展現強勁的硬體與服務增長動能。
• 營收達 1,094.2 億美元，年增率達 16.36%，顯示核心產品與服務需求依然強勁。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 達 2.02 美元，優於市場預期的 1.89 美元，獲利能力持續提升。
• 服務業務與硬體生態系統的協同效應持續擴大，推動整體毛利率表現。
ai_view:
訊號：蘋果本季展現強勁的雙位數營收增長，釋放硬體換機潮與服務變現順暢的積極訊號。短中期意涵：獲利超預期有助於支撐目前 38.15 倍的高估值，但股價進一步上行需依賴 AI 功能的實際變現與出貨貢獻。追蹤指標：下一代 iPhone 出貨量、服務業務毛利率及大中華區市場份額變化。

需留意：本益比達 38.15 倍，估值處於歷史高位，市場容錯率較低。；全球消費電子市場復甦步調不一，可能影響下一季度硬體出貨增速。

summary_en:
Apple delivers strong double-digit revenue growth and an EPS beat, driven by robust hardware and services momentum.
• Revenue reached $109.42B, up 16.36% YoY, demonstrating resilient demand across core segments.
• EPS of $2.02 beat consensus estimates of $1.89, showcasing strong operating leverage.
• Continued expansion of the services ecosystem alongside hardware upgrades bolsters overall margins.

Signal: Apple's double-digit revenue growth signals robust hardware replacement cycles and smooth services monetization. Near/mid-term implication: The earnings beat supports the elevated 38.15x P/E valuation, but further upside depends on AI feature monetization and shipment contributions. What to track: Next-generation iPhone shipments, services gross margin, and market share dynamics in Greater China.

Watch：Trailing P/E of 38.15 indicates elevated valuation, leaving little room for execution errors.; Uneven recovery in global consumer electronics markets may pressure next-quarter hardware shipment growth.
